text:
Alex Johnson  
Senior Backend Engineer | AdTech Innovations | Tel Aviv, Israel  
7 years of experience in adtech, specializing in scalable backend systems, performance optimization, and distributed architecture. Proven track record in designing high-throughput APIs, leading engineering teams, and implementing cost-effective cloud solutions.  

At AdTech Innovations, I led the optimization of core database queries, reducing latency by 40% and improving ad delivery efficiency. This involved refactoring monolithic data access layers into microservices, leveraging PostgreSQL indexing strategies, and integrating caching mechanisms. I also spearheaded the transition to Kubernetes-based deployments, enabling automated scaling for campaigns with peak request volumes exceeding 10M/day. My work on CI/CD pipelines standardized deployment workflows across 15+ services, reducing manual intervention and deployment times by 30%.  

Prior to AdTech Innovations, I served as Lead Backend Engineer at AdvertiseNow, where I architected a microservices architecture to support 20+ ad platforms. This involved designing RESTful APIs with strict SLAs, ensuring sub-100ms response times for real-time bidding. I implemented message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ) to decouple high-volume event processing from mainline workflows, improving system resilience during traffic spikes. My focus on cloud cost optimization led to a 25% reduction in AWS spend through reserved instance allocations and spot fleet strategies.  

In my early career at MediaMetrics, I built a high-performance ad-serving API handling 5M+ requests/day, written in Go for low-latency processing. This system integrated with third-party ad exchanges via RESTful endpoints and utilized Terraform for infrastructure-as-code, ensuring rapid scalability. I also developed internal tools in Python to automate monitoring and alerting for critical metrics like request latency and error rates.  

Technical expertise includes:  
- **Go**: Core language for building scalable, high-performance services at MediaMetrics and AdTech Innovations.  
- **Kubernetes**: Deployed and managed containerized workloads across 15+ microservices at AdvertiseNow and AdTech Innovations.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Optimized query performance and indexing strategies to reduce latency by 40% at AdTech Innovations.  
- **CI/CD pipelines**: Automated deployment workflows using GitLab CI and Jenkins, reducing manual intervention by 30%.  
- **Cloud cost optimization**: Reduced AWS spend by 25% through reserved instances and spot fleets at AdvertiseNow.  
- **REST API design**: Central to system architecture, mentoring junior engineers on best practices for scalability and security.  
- **Message queues**: Implemented Kafka and RabbitMQ for decoupling high-volume event processing at AdvertiseNow.  
- **Microservices architecture**: Designed and maintained a distributed system supporting 20+ ad platforms at AdvertiseNow.  
- **Terraform**: Standardized infrastructure-as-code practices for cloud provisioning and environment management.  

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Washington, 2016.
